remarks: Welcome to Linden House. This gleaming, large and very nicely updated one bedroom ground floor garden apartment has it all. Filled with natural light, with rich hardwood floors throughout and recent renovations for a modern touch this a great rental opportunity. Add the use of a storage room, an assigned parking spot, a Coin Op Laundry and Heat, Cooking Gas and Hot water included in the rent, what more could you want? Well-manicured grounds featuring mature flowering trees and shrubs that enchant in every season. Conveniently located in close proximity to Glenbrook rail station. Explore Stamford Downtown's vibrant offerings or travel to New York City effortlessly via Metro North or car. Good credit history and references are a MUST. Strictly no pets.
